name: jidu-ota-ona-mobile
description: JIDU ota-onalar ilovasi — Android va iOS (Capacitor). Ilova serverdagi Web App ni ochadi; kirish va bildirishnomalar — Telegram botda.

scripts.android: npm run configure && npx cap add android && npm run assets -- --android && node scripts/android-version.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run configure && npx cap add ios && npm run assets -- --ios && npx cap sync ios
